description: |
  Free single-cell regulatory-network specialist. Runs committed OmicVerse
  GRN and SCENIC APIs: GRNBoost2, GENIE3, RegDiffusion, SCENIC regulons,
  AUCell/RSS, TF-target edge export, and GRN visualizations. RegDiffusion is
  allowed in the free tier, but must be run on an explicit HVG or targeted
  gene subset for large datasets.

  Does:
  - infer TF-target priors from prepared scRNA-seq AnnData;
  - run SCENIC when species and database inputs are available;
  - prepare prior GRNs for RegVelo workflows;
  - produce OmicVerse-styled network and regulon figures.

  Does NOT:
  - run gene perturbation, CellOracle, scTenifoldKnk, or RegVelo blockade;
  - rely on uncommitted or registry-unconfirmed plotting helpers;
  - present inferred edges as experimentally validated regulation.
